content: Letter 31, to Amīr Sayyid Nāṣir Kārkiyā (ca. 831-32/1428-29, Gilan): a letter of greeting and congratulations on a conquest achieved with the spiritual support of Sufis, with a postscript greeting the members of the Kārkiyā court and singling out for respect the astronomer Badr al-Dīn, of the school of Ṭūsī and Ptolemy (TMN/M f. 51b, TMN/MS pp. 25-26, TMN/D pp. 199-201).
